title: Appliance bootstrap screens and upgrade UX for Private deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Scope: Produce a compact set of onboarding artwork, annotated installer screenshots, and an upgrade modal family for the Private (appliance/VPC) onboarding flow. Deliverables include: 
- High-fidelity art assets for the initial appliance bootstrap: welcome, network check, license key, progress, success.
- Annotated CLI and Console installer screenshots showing parameter mapping (CIDR, gateway, DNS, KMS note).
- Upgrade modal designs: minor patch, rolling upgrade, forced migration flows with microcopy and fallback states.
- A11y pass notes (color contrast, keyboard focus, screen-reader labels) and image alt-texts.
- Exported assets: PNG/SVG at 2x for product site, and a grayscale set for docs PDFs.
Goals: Reduce first-time setup confusion, lower support ticket volume for Private installs, and provide assets for docs, Console release notes, and the onboarding email template.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains pages for: hero art, installer screenshots, upgrade modal variants, and exports page
Design tokens documented for colors used in all assets and confirmed with frontend (ENG-1980)
Annotated screenshots include exact CLI flags and Console field mappings for installer docs
Accessibility checklist completed and signed off by UX research
Assets exported in PNG/SVG and uploaded to Drive; a PR created to add images to docs repo
